stance_rationale: As an optimizer package, this is not auditable: weights.csv is absent, the declared optimizer stage artifacts are absent, and RF-O9 walk-forward schedule verification is impossible. It also carries an unapproved union max_names=40 / comp cost 25bps exception against hard constraints, so the package cannot pass before Forge artifacts and governance approval exist.

method_shopping_audit.selection_method: DESIGN_ONLY_NO_SELECTION; no method_shopping_log_optimizer.json; effective search also includes 16 injection cells and approximately 200 hyperparameter sub-cells

cost_audit.cost_proportionality_check: FAIL: package gives formula-only cost handling; comp sleeve uses 25bps one-way versus base 15bps mandate, blend cost ceiling is unmeasured, and no turnover path exists.

hard_constraint_violations: RF-O5: union max_names forecast is 40 while base hard constraint is max_names=20
RF-O9: weights.csv absent, so no as_of_date × ticker × weight × method_selected schedule
RF-O13: turnover target is <=6.0 but hard rule is <600% annual and no measured turnover exists
Cost: comp one-way cost 25bps conflicts with base 15bps one-way mandate unless formally approved

sequential_admission_audit.integration_weight_breakdown: Protocol only: 1715 weight 80-95%, comp sleeve 5-20%; no blended SR/MDD/IR/TDC measurement.

critical_concerns.description: weights.csv is missing in the mailbox and stage artifact paths, so RF-O9 walk-forward schedule, n_names, max_w, Σw, long-only, top-alpha realization, turnover, and cost cannot be verified.

The package redefines max_names=20 as per-sleeve and forecasts union=40 before approval. AX-007 multi-sleeve precedent may be a design argument, but it is not a substitute for the base hard max_names=20 constraint without a completed Governor/Dohoon exception.

Optimizer code_implementation claims four optimizer markdown artifacts, but injection_grid_nav_pareto.md, clipping_audit_nav.md, multi_sleeve_constraint.md, and alternative_optimizer_nav.md are absent. Existing stage artifacts are alpha/risk design docs, not optimizer artifacts.

Method shopping is not controlled by an auditable log: the draft declares 10 methods, 16 injection candidates, and approximately 200 sub-cells, while selected method is deferred. This leaves RF-O10 open despite a non-Sharpe objective label.

Iter-specific alignment is incomplete: no alpha confidence_vector exists for confidence-aware MVO/BL shrinkage, heavy-tail Hill risk is acknowledged but HRP/CVaR priority is not enforced, and CRISIS-specific boundary shrink to max_w 0.10 plus cash sleeve is absent.

Cost and turnover are formula-only. Comp cost 25bps conflicts with the 15bps one-way hard mandate, turnover is targeted at <=6.0 rather than proven <6.0, and regime-switch/sleeve-rebalance cost is not internalized in actual weights.

No optimizer challenge_note or final optimization_package.json exists, yet challenge_flags is empty and challenge_review_objection=false while multi_sleeve_charter_exception_request remains pending. That is No Silent Override risk.

Stage artifacts still contain cor <=0.3 by-construction language and beta-neutralization fallback language that can create implicit short-beta exposure. That weakens long-only compliance and makes AX-007 exemption evidence incomplete.

supporting_arguments: The draft honestly labels method_selected as DESIGN_ONLY_NO_SELECTION and makes Forge handoff requirements explicit.
The declared selection objective is crowding_adj_ret rather than Sharpe-only, which is directionally better than RF-O10 cherry-picking.
Per-sleeve constraints are specified, but total portfolio and actual weights remain unaudited.
unresolved_disputes: Whether discovery_design_phase_a may bypass optimizer verification artifacts; the optimizer role prompt still requires weights.csv and hard-constraint recheck.
Whether max_names union 40 can be admitted under L-279/AX-007 without prior explicit approval.
Whether comp 25bps and KR_TOP500 construction are allowed under the base 15bps and universe mandates.
Whether beta-neutralized residual NAV is a long-only investable sleeve or an implicit hedge.
Whether AX-008 can ever pass before Forge and Architect sources exist.
weakest_assumption: The weakest weight assumption is that max_names=20 can be treated as per-sleeve, allowing a 40-name union portfolio before an approved Charter/Governor exception, while still claiming hard-constraint compliance.
rebuttal_required: Produce weights.csv with schema as_of_date × ticker × weight × method_selected and at least the mandated walk-forward sig_dates.
Either enforce total max_names<=20 or attach explicit approved exception before finalization.
Provide method_shopping_log_optimizer.json with all 10 methods, 16 injection cells, hyperparameter sub-cells, objective values, infeasible cases, and heavy-tail tie-break rule.
Generate or reference actual alpha_scores.parquet and covariance.parquet, including post-shrink PSD and condition<=100 checks.
Report measured turnover, 15/25bps cost decomposition, regime-switch cost, and annual turnover <600%.
Issue optimizer_challenge_note.md and set challenge_flags for hard-constraint exception pending until resolved.
